title: Agentic Discovery of Soundness Bugs in Safe Rust Bindings
authors: Marius Momeu, Koushik Sen
abstract: Rust crates confine unsafe code, such as calls into C or C++ libraries or system calls, behind safe interfaces that must uphold Rust's invariants. If an interface encodes one rule of the code beneath it too weakly, a program written in purely safe Rust can cause undefined behavior. Static analyzers and fuzzers are bound to fixed patterns or to the paths they execute. We propose LLM agents as auditors of these interfaces, and study how well they do it. We first define a taxonomy of the defects of such interfaces, including undefined behavior, divergences from the wrapped library, and incomplete unsafe contracts. We then measure, in repeated audits of a real-world crate by a closed and an open model, Claude Opus 5.5 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, which defect classes agents find, how well they triage them, and what makes them find more. Agents find the first two classes unprompted, but find few incomplete contracts even when asked. Their findings are almost always real, even without an independent reviewer, yet they lack triage discipline: they seldom confirm with a sanitizer, and they stop early. With the same guidance, the open model finds as many defects as the closed one at a quarter of the cost. We integrate these insights in Crustify, an agentic system for automating C-to-Rust tasks, and run it at scale. In 16 widely used crates, including the bindings to the C libraries OpenSSL, SQLite, libgit2, and libcurl and to the C++ engine V8, Crustify found 225 undefined-behavior bugs, 23 behavioral divergences, and 36 incomplete unsafe contracts, between 3 and 61 per crate at a median cost under $50 per audit. In the Linux kernel's Rust abstractions, it found 11 more undefined-behavior bugs and 4 incomplete contracts. Maintainers have fixed 26 of the 83 findings that we reported.
title_zh: 智能发现Safe Rust绑定中的健全性错误
abstract_zh: Rust crate将不安全代码（如调用C或C++库或系统调用）限制在必须维护Rust不变量的安全接口之后。如果接口对下方代码规则的编码过于薄弱，完全用安全Rust编写的程序可能导致未定义行为。静态分析器和模糊测试工具局限于固定模式或它们执行的路径。我们提出将大型语言模型(LLM)代理作为这些接口的审计者，并研究它们的审计效果。我们首先定义了此类接口缺陷的分类法，包括未定义行为、与被包装库的偏差以及不完整的不安全契约。然后，我们通过一个封闭模型(Claude Opus 5.5)和一个开放模型(DeepSeek V4.1 Flash)对真实世界的crate进行重复审计，测量它们发现的缺陷类别、分类能力以及发现更多缺陷的因素。代理能够主动发现前两类缺陷，但即使被要求，也很少发现不完整的契约。它们的发现几乎总是真实的，即使没有独立审查者，但缺乏分类纪律：它们很少使用sanitizer进行确认，并且会过早停止。在相同指导下，开放模型发现的缺陷数量与封闭模型相同，但成本仅为后者的四分之一。我们将这些见解整合到Crustify中，这是一个用于自动化C到Rust任务的代理系统，并在大规模运行。在16个广泛使用的crate中，包括对C库OpenSSL、SQLite、libgit2和libcurl的绑定以及对C++引擎V8的绑定，Crustify发现了225个未定义行为bug、23个行为偏差和36个不完整的不安全契约，每个crate发现3到61个问题，审计中位成本低于50美元。在Linux内核的Rust抽象层中，它发现了11个额外的未定义行为bug和4个不完整的契约。维护者已修复了我们报告的83个发现中的26个。

title: Vx: A Programming Language for Scalable, Maintainable and Secure Systems
authors: Aditya Kumar
abstract: A program for a modern machine runs on several kinds of chips. Its memory spaces, links and capacities are invisible to the compilers of today. So a host that reads device memory, a working set that does not fit, or a data race shows up only when the program runs. Vx is a systems programming language that puts these facts in the program text. A machine is a source file of declarations. A value's type says which memory it lives in. Apart from one stated exception, a function's signature is the whole contract that its callers see. A flag lists the code and the facts that the compiler trusts without a proof. This report is a tour of the language at one commit. It describes six design principles, the core language, and the features that serve three qualities. Vx is scalable because one program text runs across machines, cores and GPU threads. With an option, the compiler also checks its function bodies in parallel. It is maintainable because a signature is the contract of a function and most diagnostics have codes. The output of the parallel compiler does not depend on the number of threads. It is secure because safe code has ownership, borrow, race and placement checks, and in safe code, a file or a socket of the standard library opens only with a right. For every feature, the report gives its status and the evidence for it. It also lists where the implementation does not yet meet the design.
title_zh: Vx：一种用于可扩展、可维护和安全系统的编程语言
abstract_zh: 现代机器的程序运行在多种芯片上。其内存空间、链接和容量对当今的编译器是不可见的。因此，只有在程序运行时，主机读取设备内存、工作集不匹配或数据竞争等问题才会显现。Vx是一种系统编程语言，它将这些事实直接写入程序文本中。机器是一个包含声明的源文件。值的类型决定了它所在的内存空间。除一个明确指出的例外情况外，函数的签名是其调用者所见的全部契约。一个标志列出了编译器无需证明就信任的代码和事实。本报告是对某一版本提交的语言的概述。它描述了六项设计原则、核心语言以及服务于三种特性的功能。Vx具有可扩展性，因为一个程序文本可以在机器、核心和GPU线程上运行。通过一个选项，编译器还可以并行检查其函数体。它具有可维护性，因为函数签名是函数的契约，并且大多数诊断都有代码。并行编译器的输出不依赖于线程数量。它具有安全性，因为安全代码拥有所有权、借用、竞争和放置检查，并且在安全代码中，标准库的文件或套接字只有在拥有权限的情况下才能打开。对于每个功能，报告都给出了其状态和证据。它还列出了实现尚未满足设计要求的地方。

title: When Answering Is Administering: Permission Replies That Rewrite Coding-Agent Policy
authors: Zeming Fei, Hongming Fei, Jingwen Chen, Xiaoyang Wang, Prosanta Gope, Biplab Sikdar, Ying Zhang
abstract: Coding agents let plugins and remote services answer permission prompts, and Claude Code documents that such an answer cannot override the operator's deny rules. However, we show that this guarantee, checked one decision at a time, fails over a whole run, because an answer to one permission prompt can rewrite the policy that every later answer is checked against. For example, a remote service with no access to the operator's files approves an unrelated command and attaches an update that deletes the deny rule protecting the project's secrets. The agent then reads the secrets in that session and the next, even inside the vendor's strict sandbox. The root cause is that Claude Code checks only updates that add or replace allow rules. Relays that forward such deletions already exist, including the vendor's own Remote Control. In effect, the right to answer a prompt has become the right to administer the policy. Worse, the deletion leaves the same records as a local edit by the operator, so Claude Code cannot tell who wrote a rule. More generally, what a runtime records decides what it can safely delegate. A runtime that cannot tell who wrote a rule can accept only updates that keep every currently denied call denied, whereas, to protect every party's restrictions, a runtime that records who wrote each rule can let each party remove only the restrictions proven to be its own. We prove that these two bounds are tight. They correctly predict whether the operator's restrictions survive in all thirteen permission designs across ten agent systems, including predictions we wrote down before running Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode, and Goose. Enforcing the bounds at the shared update step blocks the attack. A survey of 2,227 fetched marketplace plugins finds only two that send policy updates.
title_zh: 当回答即是管理：重写编码代理政策的权限回复
abstract_zh: 编程代理允许插件和远程服务回答权限提示，而Claude Code文档表明，此类回答无法覆盖操作员的拒绝规则。然而，我们证明了一次检查一个决策的这种保证在整个运行过程中会失效，因为对一个权限提示的回答可能会重写后续所有回答所依据的策略。例如，一个无法访问操作员文件的远程服务批准了一个不相关的命令，并附加了一个删除保护项目机密信息的拒绝规则的更新。然后，代理在该会话和下一个会话中读取了这些机密信息，即使在供应商的严格沙箱内也是如此。根本原因在于Claude Code仅检查添加或替换允许规则的更新。已经存在转发此类删除的中继，包括供应商自己的远程控制。实际上，回答提示的权利已成为管理策略的权利。更糟糕的是，删除操作会留下与操作员本地编辑相同的记录，因此Claude Code无法判断是谁编写了规则。更广泛地说，运行时记录的内容决定了它可以安全委托的内容。一个无法判断谁编写规则的运行时只能接受保持当前所有被拒绝调用仍然被拒绝的更新；而为了保护各方的限制，一个记录了谁编写每条规则的运行时可以让各方仅删除被证明是其自己拥有的限制。我们证明了这两个界限是严格的。它们正确预测了操作员的限制是否能在十三个代理系统中的所有权限设计中幸存，包括我们在运行Codex、Gemini CLI、opencode和Goose之前写下的预测。在共享更新步骤执行这些界限可以阻止攻击。对2,227个获取的市场插件的调查显示，只有两个发送策略更新。

title: MALET & Katalina: A Large-Scale Dataset and Static Analysis of macOS Malware
authors: Godwin Attigah, Obinna Igbe
abstract: While malware on platforms such as Windows and Android has been extensively studied, the macOS ecosystem remains comparatively understudied. To address this gap, we present MALET, a large-scale public dataset for macOS malware analysis. MALET contains 44{,}804 malicious Mach-O binaries and 44{,}457 samples with zero antivirus detections on VirusTotal. From the undetected set, we further identify 25{,}835 high-confidence benign samples using conservative, heuristic-based filtering. We also introduce Katalina, an open-source static analysis framework that extracts macOS-specific structural features and indicators of potential behavior at scale. Using MALET, we perform, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale static characterization of macOS malware. Our analysis reveals macOS-specific traits, including widespread misuse of security entitlements, abuse of native scripting interfaces, and irregularities in code-signing infrastructure. We find that 93.0\% of malicious samples are unsigned, demonstrating that unsigned code continues to execute in practice through user-mediated approval mechanisms. Among CA-signed malware, 28.4\% (816 samples) were associated with certificates that were later revoked, including samples publicly attributed to DPRK-linked threat actors, as reflected in antivirus labels and threat intelligence reports. Finally, we identify significant detection instability: in 185 structurally identical malicious samples, antivirus engines failed to provide consistent detections for 77.2\% (143 samples). Together, these results highlight persistent blind spots in macOS malware detection and motivate improved approaches to certificate abuse analysis, similarity-based clustering, and platform-specific defense mechanisms. Based on these insights, we outline concrete steps to advance the state of macOS malware analysis and defense.
title_zh: MALET & Katalina：macOS恶意软件的大规模数据集与静态分析
abstract_zh: 尽管Windows和Android等平台上的恶意软件已被广泛研究，但macOS生态系统仍然相对研究不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MALET，一个用于macOS恶意软件分析的大规模公共数据集。MALET包含44,804个恶意Mach-O二进制文件和44,457个在VirusTotal上零杀毒软件检测的样本。从未检测到的样本中，我们使用保守的基于启发式的过滤方法进一步确定了25,835个高置信度的良性样本。我们还引入了Katalina，一个开源的静态分析框架，可大规模提取macOS特定的结构特征和潜在行为指标。利用MALET，据我们所知，我们进行了首次大规模的macOS恶意软件静态特征分析。我们的分析揭示了macOS特有的特征，包括安全权限的广泛滥用、原生脚本接口的滥用以及代码签名基础设施的不规范。我们发现93.0%的恶意样本未签名，表明未签名代码在实践中仍通过用户介导的批准机制继续执行。在CA签名的恶意软件中，28.4%（816个样本）与后来被撤销的证书相关联，包括被公开归因于与朝鲜相关的威胁行为者的样本，这反映在杀毒软件标签和威胁情报报告中。最后，我们发现了显著的检测不稳定性：在185个结构相同的恶意样本中，杀毒引擎对77.2%（143个样本）未能提供一致的检测。这些结果共同突显了macOS恶意软件检测中持续存在的盲点，并推动改进证书滥用分析、基于相似性的聚类和平台特定防御机制的方法。基于这些见解，我们概述了推进macOS恶意软件分析和防御状态的具体步骤。

title: Reading Decisions Before Spans: Efficient Generative Verification
authors: Yanbin Gong, Lei Chen
abstract: A developer checking an assistant's report may need only an alarm that a claim is unsupported. A generative verifier, however, can continue decoding to quote and classify the errors. We study how much of that output is needed to recover its decision. In a frozen 2B span verifier, the choice between an empty error list and its first object precedes all localization. Native8 stops generation at this branch. The preceding seven syntax tokens are fixed, so Prefill1 supplies them as input and generates only the unrestricted branch token, using the same native instruction. On 2,015 code-agent TEST responses, Prefill1 reduces eager resident service by 84.84% relative to full generation, with released-reference F1 of 83.43 versus 83.41. It saves 31.98% over Native8 even though their logical token totals are identical. Under default compiled execution, the extra saving is 6.74-26.73% on the complete workload, with small decision changes. Controlled evidence interventions and first-location decoding establish what these shorter readouts retain and what requires further generation.
title_zh: 阅读决策在前：高效生成式验证
abstract_zh: 检查助手报告的开发人员可能只需要一个警报，表明某个主张缺乏支持。然而，生成式验证器可以继续解码以引用和分类错误。我们研究需要多少输出才能恢复其决策。在一个冻结的2B跨度验证器中，在所有定位之前，就已经在空错误列表和第一个对象之间做出了选择。Native8在此分支处停止生成。前面的七个语法标记是固定的，因此Prefill1将它们作为输入提供，并仅生成无限制的分支标记，使用相同的本机指令。在2,015个代码代理TEST响应中，与完整生成相比，Prefill1将急切驻留服务减少了84.84%，其发布参考F1得分为83.43，而完整生成为83.41。尽管它们的逻辑标记总数相同，但它比Native8节省了31.98%。在默认编译执行下，在整个工作负载上额外节省了6.74-26.73%，决策变化很小。受控的证据干预和首次位置解码确定了这些较短的读取保留了什么，以及什么需要进一步生成。

title: MOSAIC: Memory-Organized Search with Anti-Imitation Crossover for Training-Free Microarchitecture Optimization
authors: Kaushal Mhapsekar, Bita Aslrousta, Paula Contreras, Azam Ghanbari, Samira Mirbagher Ajorpaz
abstract: Large language models can generate cache-replacement policies. The central challenge is to retain performance on workloads excluded from the search. In our adaptations of published search methods, generated code resembles established policies, with cosine similarities of 0.78-0.84. The wider comparison also shows held-out harmonic-mean instructions-per-cycle (IPC) losses of 1.0-2.4%. We present MOSAIC, a search controller that improves policies without updating language-model weights. It stores concise lessons from previous evaluations rather than repeatedly copying high-scoring code. When improvement stops, it selects two high-scoring policies whose code embeddings differ and asks the model to combine their mechanisms. Novelty prompts and model rotation support this search; controlled memory edits test how the stored lessons affect later proposals. We evaluate cache replacement using intervention-level cross-validation and a wider comparison on ten memory-intensive SPEC2006 workloads. MOSAIC reaches a 51.1% peak hit rate on the primary search workload and a 47.9% held-out mean in the intervention study. Removing crossover reduces these values by 7.8 and 21.8 percentage points, respectively, whereas the tested stronger model improves the held-out mean by 0.4 points. In the wider IPC comparison, MOSAIC has the smallest held-out gap (0.31%) and the highest held-out IPC among the evaluated LLM configurations. Adapting the same controller to data prefetching gives a 4.8% mean speedup over the LRU reference configuration. The accompanying corpus contains 10,687 generated policies with lineage and per-iteration prompt logs.
title_zh: MOSAIC：用于无训练微架构优化的基于内存组织的搜索与反模仿交叉
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型可以生成缓存替换策略。其核心挑战在于保持对搜索中未包含工作负载的性能。在我们对已发表搜索方法的改进中，生成的代码与现有策略相似，余弦相似度为0.78-0.84。更广泛的比较还显示，保留的调和平均指令周期数(IPC)损失为1.0-2.4%。我们提出了MOSAIC，一个搜索控制器，它可以在不更新语言模型权重的情况下改进策略。它存储先前评估的简洁经验教训，而不是重复复制高分代码。当改进停止时，它选择两个代码嵌入不同的高分策略，并要求模型结合它们的机制。新颖性提示和模型轮换支持这一搜索；受控的内存编辑测试存储的经验教训如何影响后续提案。我们使用干预级交叉验证和在十个内存密集型SPEC2006工作负载上的广泛比较来评估缓存替换。MOSAIC在主要搜索工作负载上达到51.1%的命中率峰值，在干预研究中达到47.9%的保留平均值。去除交叉操作分别使这些值降低7.8和21.8个百分点，而测试的更强模型将保留平均值提高了0.4个百分点。在更广泛的IPC比较中，MOSAIC在评估的LLM配置中具有最小的保留差距(0.31%)和最高的保留IPC。将相同的控制器适配到数据预取，比LRU参考配置平均提高4.8%的速度。配套语料库包含10,687个具有谱系和每轮提示日志的生成策略。

title: Network-Guided Automated Synthesis of MAC Units for Neural Network Inference
authors: Zhouyang Wu, Hongyang Pan, Chuyu Wang, Ji Zhuang, Keren Zhu, Xin Zhao, Xuan Zeng
abstract: In neural inference accelerators, multiply-accumulate (MAC) datapaths account for the majority of circuit area and critical-path delay, where operator-level numerical formats simultaneously dictate hardware overhead and quantization error. Yet no straightforward mapping exists between hardware cost and end-to-end network accuracy: logic synthesis transforms datapaths in a highly nonlinear manner, while numerical errors propagate and couple across layers. To address this disconnect, we present NAMSI, an automated network-aware MAC synthesis framework tailored for neural inference. NAMSI characterizes heterogeneous data formats using a format-distribution representation (FD) and leverages topology-aware accuracy and hardware-cost modeling (TaH), calibrated with actual post-synthesis Area-Delay Product (ADP) measurements, to jointly estimate coupled full-network accuracy and circuit cost. Furthermore, reversible lattice search (RLS) is introduced to tractably navigate the exponentially scaling design space. Evaluations across five neural networks on ImageNet-1K demonstrate that under post-training quantization (PTQ), NAMSI achieves 54.2%-60.4% reductions in post-synthesis MAC ADP compared with FP32 while retaining at least 99% of full-precision Top-1 accuracy, surpassing baseline approaches in both hardware efficiency and accuracy preservation.
title_zh: 面向神经网络推理的MAC单元网络引导自动合成
abstract_zh: 在神经推理加速器中，乘累加(MAC)数据路径占据了电路面积和关键路径延迟的主要部分，其中操作级别的数值格式同时决定了硬件开销和量化误差。然而，硬件成本与端到端网络精度之间并不存在直接的映射关系：逻辑合成以高度非线性的方式转换数据路径，而数值误差则会在各层之间传播和耦合。为了解决这种脱节问题，我们提出了NAMSI，一个专为神经推理设计的自动化网络感知MAC合成框架。NAMSI使用格式分布表示(FD)来表征异构数据格式，并利用拓扑感知的精度和硬件成本建模(TaH)，该模型通过实际的后合成面积-延迟乘积(ADP)测量进行校准，以联合估计耦合的全网络精度和电路成本。此外，我们还引入了可逆格点搜索(RLS)方法，以在指数级扩展的设计空间中进行有效导航。在ImageNet-1K上对五个神经网络的评估表明，在训练后量化(PTQ)条件下，与FP32相比，NAMSI实现了54.2%-60.4%的后合成MAC ADP降低，同时保留了至少99%的全精度Top-1精度，在硬件效率和精度保持方面均超越了基线方法。

title: Sample-Efficient In-Context Adaptation via Sleep
authors: Sangyun Lee, Zhang Enyan, Michael Xu, Hao Tang, Zinan Lin, Weijia Xu, Chris Quirk, Jianfeng Gao, Giulia Fanti, Xiaodong Liu
abstract: The ability to learn and generalize from limited experience, or sample efficiency, is a cornerstone of intelligence. How can we build language models that turn a few user interactions, a few snippets of unfamiliar code, or a handful of experimental results provided in context into knowledge that generalizes? Prior work has found that sleep, a process where the model performs $N$ recurrent forward passes to refine its representations of a chunk of context, can improve long-context reasoning (specifically, within SSM-attention hybrid models). We study whether this method also improves in-context adaptation on general, non-synthetic tasks for transformer language models. To this end, we pre-train language models up to 1.2B-parameters on up to 100B tokens with sleep mechanisms. Notably, longer sleep (i.e., using a larger number of recurrent forward passes $N$) enables the model to learn faster in-context on multiple few-shot algorithmic, question-answering tasks, while also achieving lower next-token prediction loss on out-of-distribution evaluations. On held-out code, models with $N=2$ and $N=4$ match the no-sleep baseline's loss using $2.10\times$ and $2.39\times$ fewer tokens in-context, respectively. More broadly, we view our work as a step toward building models that have better tradeoffs between in-context adaptation and decoding latency.
title_zh: 通过睡眠实现样本高效的上下文适应
abstract_zh: 从有限经验中学习和泛化的能力，即样本效率，是智能的基石。我们如何构建语言模型，使其能够将少量用户交互、几段不熟悉的代码片段或上下文中提供的少量实验结果转化为能够泛化的知识？先前的研究发现，"睡眠"机制（一种模型执行N次循环前向传递以优化其对上下文块表示的方法）可以改善长上下文推理（特别是在SSM-attention混合模型中）。我们研究了这种方法是否也能提升Transformer语言模型在一般非合成任务上的上下文适应能力。为此，我们使用睡眠机制预训练了高达120亿参数的语言模型，训练数据量达1000亿token。值得注意的是，更长的"睡眠"（即使用更多的循环前向传递次数N）使模型能够在多个少样本算法和问答任务中更快地进行上下文学习，同时在分布外评估中实现更低的下一token预测损失。在保留的代码数据上，N=2和N=4的模型分别比无睡眠基线模型少使用2.10倍和2.39倍的token上下文即可达到相同的损失。更广泛地说，我们认为我们的工作是朝着构建在上下文适应和解码延迟之间具有更好权衡的模型迈出的一步。

title: TimeTravelContainer: A Live Forking Sandbox for Stateful Agent Exploration
authors: Zizheng Guo, Yanqing Zhang, Nathaniel Pinckney, Cunxi Yu, Brucek Khailany
abstract: LLM agents that drive stateful tools (e.g., interactive shells, design environments, simulation engines) frequently need to clone, backtrack, and parallelize live sessions to support exploration. However, cloning a live session today requires serializing the tool's in-memory state to disk or relaunching from scratch, both prohibitively slow for interactive exploration. Existing agent sandboxes based on microVMs or kernel patches either serialize full guest memory to storage or require privileged deployment, limiting use on shared compute farms, personal computers, and other restricted environments. We present TimeTravelContainer (TTC), a rootless container runtime that live-forks an entire running container, including processes, memory, filesystem, and network, with copy-on-write (CoW) semantics. Because the bulk of a tool session's memory is typically read-only after the fork point, clones share it automatically and only diverged pages consume additional memory. TTC requires no kernel modifications, hardware virtualization, or root privileges, and runs on all major platforms including Linux, macOS (Apple Silicon), and Windows (WSL 2), making it deployable as a portable foundation for agent harnesses. We evaluate TTC on two agentic electronic design automation (EDA) flows as representative stateful-tool workloads: MAGE (Innovus) and EvoDRC (KLayout). TTC achieves 84.1$\times$ environment cloning speedup, 31--72% memory reduction, and 1.7--9.4$\times$ end-to-end speedup, demonstrating that live forking removes a scaling barrier for agent-driven exploration of stateful tool environments.
title_zh: TimeTravelContainer：用于有状态代理探索的实时分支沙箱
abstract_zh: 驱动有状态工具（例如交互式shell、设计环境、仿真引擎）的LLM代理通常需要克隆、回溯和并行化实时会话以支持探索。然而，如今克隆实时会话需要将工具的内存状态序列化到磁盘或从头重新启动，这两种方法对于交互式探索来说都慢得令人望而却步。基于微虚拟机或内核补丁的现有代理沙盒要么将完整的客户机内存序列化到存储，要么需要特权部署，这限制了其在共享计算农场、个人计算机和其他受限环境中的使用。我们提出了TimeTravelContainer（TTC），一种无根容器运行时，它可以通过写时复制（CoW）语义实时分叉整个正在运行的容器，包括进程、内存、文件系统和网络。由于工具会话的大部分内存在分叉点后通常是只读的，因此克隆会自动共享这部分内存，只有发生变化的页面才会消耗额外内存。TTC不需要内核修改、硬件虚拟化或root权限，并且可以在所有主要平台上运行，包括Linux、macOS（Apple Silicon）和Windows（WSL 2），使其可以作为代理测试框架的可移植基础进行部署。我们在两个代理电子设计自动化（EDA）流程上评估了TTC，作为有状态工具工作负载的代表：MAGE（Innovus）和EvoDRC（KLayout）。TTC实现了84.1倍的环境克隆加速，31-72%的内存减少，以及1.7-9.4倍的端到端加速，这表明实时分叉消除了代理驱动探索有状态工具环境时的扩展障碍。

title: AgentDRC: Multi-Agent Algorithms for Spatially-Aware Automated DRC Correction
authors: Pengju Liu, Nuo Xu, Winso Chen, Peijun Li, Yang, Zhao, Yu Cao, Caiwen Ding
abstract: Design Rule Checking (DRC) error fixing remains a time-consuming bottleneck in physical design, often requiring manual intervention despite advanced EDA optimizations. Existing LLM-agent approaches fall short due to redundant contextual shapes, limited spatial reasoning over raw coordinates, and inefficient flat layout representations. We propose AgentDRC, which formulates iterative DRC correction as a multi-agent algorithm and introduces a spatial-aware verification and correction algorithm that reconstructs structured spatial relations among critical shapes and validates fixes through geometric and semantic constraint checking. The system coordinates four specialized agents to perceive multi-level, multi-modal geometric features, filter irrelevant shapes, and iteratively correct violations. Experiments show that AgentDRC achieves up to 30.4% pass@1 and 55.7% pass@5 on challenging violations, with 13.8% pass@5 improvement over the best baseline. We will open-source all code and benchmark tasks upon acceptance.
title_zh: AgentDRC：面向空间感知的自动化DRC修正多智能体算法
abstract_zh: 设计规则检查(DRC)错误修复在物理设计中仍然是一个耗时的瓶颈，尽管有先进的EDA优化，通常仍需要人工干预。现有的LLM代理方法由于冗余的上下文形状、对原始坐标的有限空间推理以及低效的平面布局表示而表现不佳。我们提出了AgentDRC，它将迭代DRC校正制定为多代理算法，并引入了一种空间感知验证和校正算法，该算法重建关键形状之间的结构化空间关系，并通过几何和语义约束检查来验证修复效果。该系统协调四个专业代理，以感知多级别、多模态的几何特征，过滤无关形状，并迭代地纠正违规。实验表明，AgentDRC在具有挑战性的违规问题上实现了高达30.4%的pass@1和55.7%的pass@5，比最佳基线提高了13.8%的pass@5。我们将在论文被接受后开源所有代码和基准任务。

title: Not Just Any Example: Security Requirements and Fix Patterns for Guiding LLM Vulnerability Repair
authors: Zichen Liu, Liangyi Huang, Stanley Nguyen, Kha Tu Nguyen, Xinda Wang, Xusheng Xiao
abstract: Software vulnerabilities leave systems open to attack, and their remediation is often delayed. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced automated patch generation, yet passing functionality tests does not ensure that a patch enforces the security requirement the vulnerability violated. Existing vulnerability repair techniques rely on curated patterns or templates with limited coverage, leaving unclear which repair strategies carry over across vulnerabilities and how they can steer LLMs. We present a large-scale empirical study that relates recurring fix patterns to the security impacts of vulnerabilities and examines how this knowledge can guide LLM-based repair. Building on a manual study of security patches, we cluster 3,816 security patches from 348 open-source repositories and analyze the edits and their context to derive concrete fix patterns, ranging from local safeguards to coordinated changes across multiple locations. We define 12 security impact classes by the security requirements that vulnerabilities violate and map them to repair categories and fix patterns, revealing characteristic repairs, alternative strategies within a class, and patterns shared across classes. We then use these patterns and impact-pattern associations to select repair examples for four LLMs on repair tasks of varying complexity. Guided example selection raises the four-model mean pass@3 from 37.9% under zero-shot prompting to up to 49.2%, whereas randomly selected examples reach only 36.9%. Our findings connect vulnerability characterization with patch generation and support organizing repair knowledge around security requirements.
title_zh: 不仅仅是任何示例：指导LLM漏洞修复的安全要求和修复模式
abstract_zh: 软件漏洞使系统容易受到攻击，而其修复往往被延迟。大型语言模型（LLMs）已推进了自动补丁生成，但通过功能测试并不能确保补丁强制执行了漏洞所违反的安全要求。现有的漏洞修复技术依赖于覆盖范围有限的精选模式或模板，不清楚哪些修复策略可以跨漏洞应用，以及它们如何引导大型语言模型。我们进行了一项大规模实证研究，将重复出现的修复模式与漏洞的安全影响联系起来，并研究了这些知识如何指导基于大型语言模型的修复。基于对安全补丁的手动研究，我们对来自348个开源存储库的3,816个安全补丁进行聚类，并分析其编辑及其上下文以推导具体的修复模式，范围从局部保护措施到跨多个位置的协调变更。我们根据漏洞违反的安全要求定义了12个安全影响类别，并将它们映射到修复类别和修复模式，揭示了特征性修复、类别内的替代策略以及跨类别共享的模式。然后，我们使用这些模式和影响-模式关联，为四个大型语言模型在复杂度不同的修复任务中选择修复示例。在引导示例选择下，四个模型的平均pass@3从零样本提示下的37.9%提高到最高49.2%，而随机选择的示例仅达到36.9%。我们的研究结果将漏洞特征描述与补丁生成联系起来，并支持围绕安全要求组织修复知识。

title: Shuttle: Dependency-Attributed Workflow Evolution for Smart Contract Auditing
authors: Yue Xue, Yi Rong, Ziqiao Kong, Ronghui Gu, Dan She, Yuannan Yang, Zhiju Yang, Yuqiang Sun
abstract: In LLM-based smart contract auditing, detection quality depends on both model capability and workflow design. While coding agents can revise workflows from execution feedback, unconstrained rewrites rarely yield stable gains. Cross-function vulnerabilities require multi-step state tracking and boundary reasoning that coarse pipelines miss. End-to-end outcomes hide which step lost a clue, so direct rewrites regress existing hits or discard valid edits under coarse aggregate scoring. Repeatedly iterating on a small project set also adds case-specific heuristics that bloat prompts and hurt generalization. We present Shuttle, a constrained workflow-evolution system, and LucidScan, the auditing framework it evolves. Shuttle centers on provenance-graph attribution: it expands each run into an instance-level dependency graph, locates the node where a clue was lost via forward search, and traces existing hits backward into a protected set. After evaluating a merged batch, Shuttle drops dragging edits via a node-level provenance ledger, falling back to cache-reusing local re-runs only when early-round edits overlap on the same node. For localized bottlenecks, Shuttle generates edits under task decomposition, progressive refinement, and generality blind review. On 10 training projects, Shuttle evolves LucidScan from $G_0$ (28.7% per-project average C/H/M recall) to $G_8$ (82.1%). On 13 held-out validation projects under the same model, average recall rises from 28.6% ($G_0$) to 70.3% ($G_8$), above Pashov and Codex Security. In an anonymized live public audit contest with 896 researchers (Nov. 2026), the evolved scanner tied for #1 in High-severity recall (6/8, 75.0%), ranked #2 in scored H/M clusters (34/72, 47.2%) with 92.9% validity (78/84), and finished #3 overall.
title_zh: 穿梭：面向智能合约审计的依赖归因工作流演化
abstract_zh:
在基于大语言模型(LLM)的智能合约审计中，检测质量取决于模型能力和工作流程设计。虽然编码代理可以根据执行反馈修改工作流程，但无约束的重写很少能带来稳定的提升。跨函数漏洞需要多步骤状态跟踪和边界推理，而粗略的管道会忽略这些需求。端到端的结果掩盖了哪个步骤丢失了线索，因此直接重写会导致现有检测结果的回退或在粗略的聚合评分下丢弃有效的修改。反复在小型项目集上迭代也会增加特定案例的启发式方法，这会使提示词膨胀并损害泛化能力。

我们提出了Shuttle，一个受约束的工作流程演化系统，以及它所演化的审计框架LucidScan。Shuttle专注于来源图归因：它将每次运行扩展为实例级依赖图，通过前向搜索定位丢失线索的节点，并将现有检测结果反向追踪到受保护集合中。在评估合并批次后，Shuttle通过节点级来源分类账丢弃拖累性能的修改，仅在早期轮次的修改在同一节点重叠时才回退到缓存重用的本地重新运行。对于局部瓶颈，Shuttle在任务分解、渐进式泛化和通用性盲审下生成修改。在10个训练项目上，Shuttle将LucidScan从$G_0$(28.7%的每项目平均C/H/M召回率)演化到$G_8$(82.1%)。在相同模型下的13个保留验证项目上，平均召回率从28.6%($G_0$)提升到70.3%($G_8$)，高于Pashov和Codex Security。在一个有896名研究人员参与的匿名化公开实时审计竞赛中(2026年11月)，演化后的扫描仪在高严重性召回率上并列第一(6/8, 75.0%)，在评分H/M集群中排名第二(34/72, 47.2%)，有效性达92.9%(78/84)，总体排名第三。

title: From Grammar Deltas to Token Masks: Incremental Constrained Decoding under Runtime Grammar Evolution
authors: Hantao Hua, Jiming Su, Yonggang Che, Feng Zhu
abstract: Grammar-constrained decoding enables large language models to generate outputs that satisfy formal constraints, but in code and domain-specific language generation, the relevant constraints are not always fully available before decoding and may emerge progressively from new declarations, inferred type information, or runtime analysis feedback. Existing structured-decoding engines efficiently handle fixed, predeclared, or previously seen constraint structures; however, when a first-seen grammar update changes the parser state induced by an already committed prefix, the straightforward solution reconstructs the constraint state under the updated grammar, repeating parsing work already performed over the prefix. We introduce GramDelta, an incremental framework for constrained decoding with append-only runtime grammar updates. GramDelta maintains parse state over the committed prefix and propagates only changes induced by newly added grammar rules through historical dependencies, avoiding prefix replay. It then maps the updated parse state to exact next-token masks via compilation-free factorized projection over shared historical charts, avoiding per-update mask-cache recompilation. GramDelta therefore preserves the result of full reconstruction while making update cost sensitive to the actual impact of a grammar change. Experiments across four model configurations show that GramDelta adds negligible overhead without updates; under sustained runtime grammar evolution, it reduces median first-seen grammar-update latency by 10.7--11.5x and reduces the additional TPOT overhead over unconstrained decoding by 53.1--81.9% relative to the strongest reconstruction baseline. These results enable efficient constrained decoding when constraints progressively emerge and evolve with the generated prefix.
title_zh: 从语法增量到标记掩码：运行时语法演化下的增量约束解码
abstract_zh: 语法约束解码使大型语言模型能够生成满足形式约束的输出，但在代码和领域特定语言生成中，相关约束在解码前并不总是完全可用，而是可能从新的声明、推断的类型信息或运行时分析反馈中逐步显现。现有的结构化解码引擎能够高效处理固定、预声明或先前已见的约束结构；然而，当一个首次出现的语法更新改变了已提交前缀所诱导的解析器状态时，直接解决方案会在更新后的语法下重建约束状态，重复执行已在前缀上完成的分析工作。我们引入了GramDelta，这是一个支持仅追加运行时语法更新的增量约束解码框架。GramDelta在已提交前缀上维护解析状态，并通过历史依赖关系仅传播新添加语法规则所引起的变化，避免前缀重放。然后，它通过无编译的共享历史图表分解投影将更新后的解析状态映射到精确的下一词元掩码，避免了每次更新后的掩码缓存重新编译。因此，GramDelta在保持完全重建结果的同时，使更新成本与语法变化的实际影响相关。在四种模型配置上的实验表明，GramDelta在无更新时增加的开销可忽略不计；在持续的运行时语法演化下，它将首次出现的语法更新延迟降低了10.7-11.5倍，并且与最强的重建基线相比，将无约束解码之上的额外TPOT开销减少了53.1-81.9%。这些结果使得在约束随生成前缀逐步出现和演化的情况下实现高效的约束解码成为可能。

title: VISE: Verifier-Independent Skill Self-Evolution with Feedback from Tool Implementations
authors: Yuxuan Liu, Chongyang Du, Yuhao Zhang, Jiahe Guo, Kawai Chung, Wenbin Hu, Huihao Jing, Hongyu Luo, Qing Zong, Haochen Shi, Haoran Li, Yangqiu Song
abstract: Agent skills provide reusable workflows that guide LLM agents in using tools. Refining these workflows requires feedback on missing or incorrect instructions, but task-specific verifiers are not always available. We propose VISE (Verifier-Independent Skill Evolution), a scripts-first approach that uses tool implementations to guide skill revision. It extracts tool capabilities, input requirements, usage conditions, and output formats from source code. Using the task request and execution trace, it compares this information with current workflow instructions to identify missing or conflicting steps. It then recommends specific edits to SKILL.md, linking each change to the relevant implementation and usage conditions. We evaluate VISE as an additional revision stage for four evolution methods on SkillsBench and SkillLearnBench. Compared with the corresponding No-verifier conditions, it improves overall average task success by 9.14-13.35 percentage points. The proportion of tasks solved in all three runs increases by 12.36-18.29 points. A case study shows how revised instructions connect tool outputs to later steps. These results support tool implementations as a practical feedback source for skill self-evolution.
title_zh: VISE：基于工具实现反馈的验证器无关技能自进化
abstract_zh: 代理技能提供了可重用的工作流程，指导LLM代理使用工具。完善这些工作流程需要关于缺失或不正确指令的反馈，但任务特定的验证器并不总是可用。我们提出了VISE（验证器无关的技能进化），一种基于脚本的方法，它利用工具实现来指导技能修订。它从源代码中提取工具功能、输入要求、使用条件和输出格式。利用任务请求和执行轨迹，它将此信息与当前工作流程指令进行比较，以识别缺失或冲突的步骤。然后，它推荐对SKILL.md进行具体编辑，将每个更改链接到相关的实现和使用条件。我们在SkillsBench和SkillLearnBench上，将VISE作为四种进化方法的额外修订阶段进行评估。与相应的无验证器条件相比，它将整体平均任务成功率提高了9.14-13.35个百分点。在所有三次运行中解决的任务比例增加了12.36-18.29个百分点。案例研究展示了修订后的指令如何将工具输出与后续步骤连接起来。这些结果支持将工具实现作为技能自我进化的实用反馈源。

title: Fix How It Acts, Not How It Thinks: Surgical Fine-Tuning of Frontier LLMs
authors: Sandeep Singh Sandha, Prann Bansal, Arvind Sundararajan
abstract: Open-weight LLMs are competent software engineers, but they sometimes fail at tasks they are otherwise able to do. Often it is not a failure of reasoning. It is a few small missteps over a long trajectory (repeating a step that has already failed, or declaring the task done while a requirement is still unmet) that make the difference. Correcting this calls for a surgical weight update that steers the model toward the right actions without interfering with its reasoning. Such updates, typically learned with LoRA adapters, are often too small to survive merging into a released checkpoint. In our BF16 release, the median weight change is only 1.5% of a single rounding step, and merging loses roughly two thirds of the update's norm. When the same adapter is merged into the mixed FP8/NVFP4 release of the same model, 93% of the update disappears. Instead of increasing the size of the update, we directly train on the surviving part. We introduce merge-aware fine-tuning. Standard LoRA rounds the merged weights to the storage format only at export, so the loss never sees the rounded weights. We instead round the sum of base weights and adapter update to the release format at every training step, keeping the vendor's quantization scales, and compute the loss on these weights. The forward pass matches the serving engine numerics, and the gradient passes straight through the rounding, so the model we train is the model we ship. The loss optimizes only the model's actions and keeps its reasoning close to the base model. Applied to Nemotron-3.5, the recipe improves agentic coding in both the BF16 and the NVFP4 release, by up to 8.4 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and we publicly release both models.
title_zh: 修复其行为，而非其思维：对前沿大语言模型的精细调整
abstract_zh: 开源大语言模型是能干的软件工程师，但它们有时会在自己本能够完成的任务上失败。这通常不是推理能力的失败，而是在漫长的执行过程中出现的一些小失误（重复已经失败的步骤，或者在需求尚未满足时就宣布任务完成）导致了差异。纠正这一点需要一种外科手术式的权重更新，使模型朝向正确的行动，同时不干扰其推理能力。这类更新通常通过LoRA适配器学习，但它们通常太小，无法在合并到发布的检查点后保持效果。在我们的BF16版本中，中位数权重变化仅为单个舍入步骤的1.5%，而合并会损失大约三分之二的更新范数。当同一个适配器合并到同一模型的混合FP8/NVFP4版本中时，93%的更新会消失。我们没有增加更新的规模，而是直接对幸存的部分进行训练。我们引入了合并感知微调。标准的LoRA仅在导出时将合并的权重舍入到存储格式，因此损失函数从未看到舍入后的权重。我们在每个训练步骤中将基础权重和适配器更新的总和舍入到发布格式，保持供应商的量化比例，并基于这些权重计算损失。前向传播与服务的数值计算相匹配，梯度直接通过舍入传递，因此我们训练的模型就是我们发布的模型。损失函数仅优化模型的行动，同时保持其推理能力接近基础模型。应用于Nemotron-3.5时，该方法在BF16和NVFP4版本中都改进了代理编程能力，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上提高了最多8.4分，并且我们公开发布了这两个模型。

title: Increasing the Precision of IR Mapping for Incremental Data Analysis
authors: Anushri Jana, Kush Goradiya, Uday P Khedker
abstract: Static analysis tools operate on an Intermediate Representation (IR) --- an internal model of the program on which dataflow analysis computes and stores facts against IR object identifiers. Incremental dataflow analysis reuses these cached facts across consecutive program versions, but requires an accurate mapping between IR objects in the old and new versions. When this mapping is imprecise, the consequence is not merely a missed optimization: unmapped IR objects inflate the change set, increasing the number of program points that the analyzer must recompute and forcing it to redo work that a more precise mapping would have avoided. This cost is not specific to any one kind of IR object; it arises wherever IR-level identity is unstable across versions. Any IR that decomposes nested source expressions generates temporary variables which are assigned names by a method-local counter that shifts whenever a statement is inserted or deleted earlier in the method, breaking any name- or attribute-based mapping. We present a systematic algorithm that establishes a sound, oneto-one mapping of these temporary variables across consecutive versions, and formalize and prove the soundness of the mapping, guaranteeing that every produced mapping is semantically correct. The resulting precise mapping shrinks the change set, reducing the number of program points the incremental analysis must recompute. Implemented within the Soot framework for Jimple IR and evaluated on 8 real-world Java projects with genuine edits from the BUGSWARM dataset, our approach reduces the IR change set by over 82% on average compared to Reviser's graph-differencing algorithm, while completing the full pipeline within 250 ms per project---directly countering the common assumption that a more precise change set necessarily costs more time to compute.
title_zh: 提高IR映射精度以进行增量数据分析
abstract_zh: 静态分析工具在中间表示(IR)上运行——这是一种程序的内部模型，数据流分析在该模型上计算并针对IR对象标识符存储事实。增量数据流分析在连续的程序版本中重用这些缓存的事实，但需要新旧版本中IR对象之间的准确映射。当这种映射不精确时，后果不仅仅是错失优化机会：未映射的IR对象会扩大变更集，增加分析器必须重新计算的程序点数量，并迫使其重新执行更精确的映射本可避免的工作。这种成本并非特定于任何一种IR对象；只要IR级标识在版本间不稳定，就会产生这种问题。任何分解嵌套源表达式的IR都会生成临时变量，这些变量通过方法局部计数器分配名称，当方法中较早位置插入或删除语句时，计数器会发生变化，从而破坏了基于名称或属性的映射。我们提出了一种系统化的算法，能够在连续版本中建立这些临时变量的正确一对一映射，并形式化和证明了该映射的正确性，确保每个生成的映射在语义上都是正确的。这种精确的映射缩小了变更集，减少了增量分析必须重新计算的程序点数量。我们在Soot框架中实现了该方法，用于Jimple IR，并在BUGSWARM数据集的8个真实Java项目上进行了评估，这些项目包含真实的编辑。与Reviser的图差异算法相比，我们的方法平均将IR变更集减少了82%以上，同时每个项目的完整处理流程在250毫秒内完成——直接反驳了更精确的变更集必然需要更多计算时间的普遍假设。

title: AI-Generated Code Issues: A Taxonomy from Repository Histories, AI Conversations, and Developer Interviews
authors: Rosalia Tufano, Nargiz Humbatova, Daniele Bifolco, Gunel Jahangirova, Fiorella Zampetti, Massimiliano Di Penta, Paolo Tonella, Gabriele Bavota
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate source code, yet the quality issues in such code remain only partially understood. Understanding these issues can help developers adapt quality assurance practices, such as code review and testing, to better detect problems that may be more common in AI-generated than in human-written code. We study how quality issues in AI-generated code manifest in real software development activities through a mixed-method empirical study that draws on evidence from three complementary sources. First, we mine GitHub commits whose messages explicitly attribute a fix to a problem in AI-generated code, and we manually inspect the 914 matched commits to remove false positives and classify the quality issue being corrected. Second, we collect developers' shared conversations with AI tools, identify conversations including source code and textual signals of model mistakes, and manually analyze 299 of them to classify the underlying quality issue. Third, we interview 20 practitioners and researchers who use AI coding tools to enrich and validate the obtained catalog of quality issues. From these analyses, we derive a taxonomy of 87 types of developer-attributed quality issues in AI-generated code, going beyond functional bugs. Our findings contribute an empirically grounded taxonomy and implications for the design and evaluation of AI coding assistants and agents.
title_zh: AI生成代码问题：基于仓库历史、AI对话和开发者访谈的分类法
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地用于生成源代码，但此类代码中的质量问题仍仅被部分理解。理解这些问题可以帮助开发者调整质量保证实践，如代码审查和测试，以便更好地检测在AI生成代码中可能比人工编写代码中更常见的问题。我们通过一项混合方法实证研究来研究AI生成代码中的质量问题如何在真实的软件开发活动中体现，该研究借鉴了三个互补来源的证据。首先，我们挖掘GitHub提交记录，其提交信息明确将修复归因于AI生成代码中的问题，我们手动检查了914个匹配的提交记录，以排除误报并分类所修正的质量问题。其次，我们收集开发者与AI工具的共享对话，识别包含源代码和模型错误文本信号的对话，并手动分析其中的299个对话，以分类潜在的质量问题。第三，我们采访了20位使用AI编码工具的从业者和研究人员，以丰富和验证所获得的质量问题目录。通过这些分析，我们得出了一个包含87种开发者归因的AI生成代码质量问题的分类法，超越了功能性错误。我们的研究贡献了一个基于实证的分类法以及对AI编码助手和代理设计与评估的启示。

title: Generating Property-Based Regression Tests from Source Code Semantics
authors: Clemens Bauer, Johann Glock, Martin Pinzger
abstract: Conventional unit tests (CUTs) check a method under test at fixed concrete inputs. A test can therefore miss a regression if its input produces the expected output despite a fault. Property-based testing (PBT) checks universally quantified specifications across many randomly generated inputs, but writing properties and input generators by hand is difficult. Existing approaches automate PBT creation by generalizing an existing or generated unit test suite. They either over-approximate concrete inputs across repetitive tests or apply single-path symbolic analysis along concrete test runs. This paper presents an approach that derives property-based regression tests directly from source code semantics via multipath symbolic execution (SE). For each explored path through a target method, the approach records a path semantics comprising the path condition, the symbolic return value, and the state change map. Each path semantics induces a Hoare triple that compiles into an executable property. Because SE leaves parts of a class unspecified, the approach complements the generated properties with search-based CUTs for the whole class. We evaluate our Java implementation against EvoSuite and the test generalization tool Teralizer on EqBench and on 11 projects from TOGBench. On EqBench, our approach keeps validated properties for 82.0% of all methods. Its mean mutation score of 63.8% exceeds the 55.2% of EvoSuite and the 60.3% of Teralizer. On TOGBench, target selection, SE limitations, and property validation restrict validated properties to 2.8% of all methods. The resulting mean mutation score of 48.6% falls below the 50.9% of EvoSuite and the 51.1% of Teralizer. Failures during test generation leave a few classes without effective tests and lead to this gap.
title_zh: 从源代码语义生成基于属性的回归测试
abstract_zh: 传统单元测试(CUTs)在固定的具体输入下测试被测方法。因此，如果一个测试的输入尽管存在故障仍能产生预期输出，测试可能会遗漏回归问题。基于属性的测试(PBT)在许多随机生成的输入上检查全量规范，但手动编写属性和输入生成器很困难。现有方法通过泛化现有或生成的单元测试套件来自动化PBT的创建。它们要么在重复测试中过度近似具体输入，要么沿着具体测试运行应用单路径符号分析。本文提出了一种通过多路径符号执行(SE)直接从源代码语义派生基于属性的回归测试的方法。对于目标方法的每条探索路径，该方法记录包含路径条件、符号返回值和状态变化映射的路径语义。每条路径语义诱导出一个可编译为可执行属性的Hoare三元组。由于SE保留了类的部分未指定内容，该方法通过针对整个类的基于搜索的CUT来补充生成的属性。我们在EqBench和TOGBench的11个项目上，将我们的Java实现与EvoSuite和测试泛化工具Teralizer进行了评估。在EqBench上，我们的方法为82.0%的所有方法保留了验证的属性。其63.8%的平均变异得分超过了EvoSuite的55.2%和Teralizer的60.3%。在TOGBench上，目标选择、SE限制和属性验证将验证的属性限制在所有方法的2.8%。 resulting平均变异得分48.6%低于EvoSuite的50.9%和Teralizer的51.1%。测试生成过程中的失败导致一些类没有有效测试，从而造成了这一差距。
